assertion_audit.failure_condition: Fixture phases cease to be blocked or the positive control is not promotable before requests and settlement; these are fixture preconditions, not regression coverage.
Reverting delivery separation counts queued or ledger-settled pointers as delivered, loses the two queued requests, or fails to read global ordering.
Dropping propagation through the real transition/scoped-event path or dropping the new rendered counters removes independently expected 1d, 2p or @1.
Removing queued-duty suppression adds requested/waiting rows, removing ledger settlement adds the leftover, or the classified summary returns counts other than independently fixed 1/2/1.

The published snapshot disagrees with the direct obligations population or fails to report the independently seeded landed pointer; parity equalities alone could share a bug, so the preceding literal population assertions supply their independent anchors.
The MCP view refuses the read or returns summary values different from the directly checked fixture counts; no expected count is supplied as an input to the production API.

Restoring command placeholders, losing the MCP form, returning observe for review, omitting synchronous wait or routing the receipt outside the fixture repository makes these command/receipt assertions fail.
A command that merely enqueues or observes leaves the pointer present or fails to append the independent run identity to the fixture ledger, including all three role cases.

Ignoring request/receipt identity in snapshot reuse serves delivered after a request, suppresses the wrong debt, or fails to restore delivered after refusal; unchanged blocked phase is a control proving classification did not depend on a rewritten pointer.
Counting the peer session as own or computing queue positions from session-local rows instead of the global owner returns a count other than 0/1 or position other than 2.
Trusting stored promotion labels instead of durable requests makes a still-promotable run queued or changes independently expected delivered/queued counts 1/0.
Dropping cross-project aggregation or choosing the newest/local request yields counts other than the independently specified sums 3/3 or position other than 5.

Removing the _run_changed_nothing check invents a no-commit waiver and promotes dirty work: refusal, named path, command, surviving pointer or empty ledger assertions fail; uncommitted-control.log records this mutation failing.
Removing --wait handling from action_form prevents the form from parsing or dispatching, or an asynchronous tool completion leaves the fixture pointer present.

assertion_independence: No added assertion relies solely on echoing an expected value handed to the code under test; cross-surface parity checks have independent literal fixture-count assertions before them.

findings.text: blocking: The unconditional promotion counter and position consume the existing reason budget: delivery-after-importers.log:1765-1768 records test_the_refusal_is_named_on_the_request_s_row_and_it_stays_queued losing the actionable `reckon crew review` verb to `reckon crew …`, so a pane row no longer tells its reader how to clear the refusal; preserve a usable remedy while fitting the added counters and reconcile the affected importer assertion before landing.

justifications.durability: tests/test_delivered_rows_say_what_is_owed.py:158-401 has independent fixture counts, durable ledger/pointer checks and a refusal control that fail under the corresponding reversions, but no added assertion protects the remedy width lost at ticker.py:782.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_delivered_rows_say_what_is_owed.py:158 exercises the requested populations and CLI/MCP paths with recorded positive and negative logs, while delivery-after-importers.log records 21 added failures rather than the zero required by prompt.txt:252.

justifications.reuse: Capability searches for promotion summaries, request readers, oldest requests and fleet counts found promotion_requests.py:169/248 and recovery_watch.py:2088/3157; _delivery_reading wraps the existing reader, delivery_summary adds the shared classified projection, and _oldest_promotion_fields extends the existing aggregation rather than duplicating queue ordering.
justifications.scope_discipline: The six paths in the diff match manifest.md:3 and the three-path extension in resume-1-advice.txt:1, with no plan or unrelated source edits.
